pool: the 27 core panels of dataset/panel-pack.md; the two A1 extension panels excluded
algorithm: random.Random(seed): one treatment permutation (itertools order) for the three doubled cells, then each cell's panels by rng.sample over its three, cells in class-major order (draw_ladder_panels.py); uniform over the 118,098 admissible draws (6 permutations of the doubled cells x 3^9 cell fillings)
